name: betsim
description: Betsim - Monte Carlo betting simulator (Electron + FastAPI + SQLite)

scripts.install: if not exist .venv python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,vite,electron -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.lint: .venv\Scripts\python -m ruff check backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: .venv\Scripts\python -m pytest backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
